title: Bronze Rewards Card: Credit Limit and Spending Guidelines
summary: This document explains the Bronze Rewards Card credit limit range ($3,000–$32,500), guidance for keeping utilization low, timing purchases around the statement cycle, and requesting advance limit reviews. It also covers a 2.75% foreign transaction fee, temporary authorization holds (hotels/rental cars/fuel), and monitoring available credit with limit reviews using recent income information.
faqs: What is the Bronze Rewards Card credit limit range after approval?
How can I keep my credit utilization low and avoid declines?
When should I plan larger purchases relative to my statement cycle?
Is there a foreign transaction fee, and when does it apply?
What temporary credit holds can reduce my available credit (hotels, rental cars, fuel)?
How do I request a credit limit review if my spending needs or income change?
